name: Joseph Martin
summary: Posters and original drawings for a hatmaker and independent American brand.
description: Joseph Martin and Tangerine: event posters and original drawings for a hatmaker and independent American brand.
intro: A developing relationship with Joseph Martin, a hatmaker and independent American brand.
So far: event posters and original drawings. Red ink, open country, and a sense of humor about all of it.
ogAlt: Joseph Martin Hatmaker poster for the Double Decker Arts Festival

artifacts.title: Joseph Martin Hatmaker at the Double Decker Arts Festival
artifacts.alt: Purple and violet poster: JOSEPH MARTIN HATMAKER in heavy white slab letters over a field at dusk, a red double-decker bus on the horizon and a cowboy on horseback in the foreground
artifacts.note: Festival poster for Oxford, Mississippi: slab lettering over a violet field, a red double-decker bus on the horizon and a rider in the grass.

artifacts.title: *Martin Survives!*
artifacts.alt: Framed red-ink event poster titled Martin Survives! with a drawing of a horse and rider
artifacts.note: Event poster in red ink, shown framed.

artifacts.title: *Don't Call It Luck!*
artifacts.alt: Framed red-ink event poster titled Don't Call It Luck! with a cowboy riding a bucking horse
artifacts.note: Companion poster, same hand and the same red.

artifacts.title: *Cowboy George*
